paragraphs.text:
Lost  in  thought,  you  jump  as  Sylvia  touches  your  elbow  to 
relieve you. You check on the sleeper before turning in. His 
condition seems be deteriorating by the hour.
Make a First Aid roll: if you succeed, go to 182; if you fail, go to 181.
